summary: Tested Pascal character clipping fix and DIN/ISO measurement system implementation across multiple viewport sizes. CRITICAL SUCCESS: Pascal's head is fully visible with no clipping on all tested viewports. However, measurement-system.css is not being loaded in the browser.

critical_bugs.issue: CSS file created in /app/apps/web/app/measurement-system.css but not loaded by browser. The application builds from /app/apps/site/ (Vite), not /app/apps/web/ (Next.js). The CSS file needs to be imported in /app/apps/site/src/main.tsx or referenced in globals.css
critical_bugs.impact: DIN/ISO measurement system (8-pt grid, fluid typography, target sizes) not applied globally. CSS custom properties --unit, --t-body, --phi are undefined
critical_bugs.root_cause: Wrong directory - file created in /app/apps/web/ but app builds from /app/apps/site/
critical_bugs.fix_required: Import measurement-system.css in /app/apps/site/src/main.tsx after globals.css import, then rebuild with 'cd /app/apps/site && yarn build' and restart frontend

action_item_for_main_agent: CRITICAL FIX SUCCESSFUL: Pascal's head clipping is completely resolved across all viewport sizes! However, measurement-system.css needs to be imported. The file was created in /app/apps/web/app/ but the app builds from /app/apps/site/. Add this import to /app/apps/site/src/main.tsx after line 7: import '../../web/app/measurement-system.css'; Then rebuild: cd /app/apps/site && node scripts/generate-public-data.mjs && node node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js build --outDir /app/.local/emergent-preview-dist --emptyOutDir && sudo supervisorctl restart frontend
